# mailkit

> Email delivery for Rust: SMTP, Resend, AWS SES, SendGrid, and Postmark
> providers with MIME multipart building, queueing, and audit logging.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): provider matrix, MIME semantics, usage.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): numbered requirements REQ-MK-001..901 with test traceability.
- [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model and security mitigations.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
